svg.title: Rynce — Flagship · Live product
svg.desc: Split group expenses, track personal spending and settle up — one product across a Next.js web app and a native Android client, with live encrypted chat. Platforms: Web · Native Android. Stack: Next.js 16 · Kotlin · PostgreSQL. Security: Passkeys · MFA · Encrypted chat. Reach: Multi-currency · 10 languages.
